name: NLP
description: Natural language processing: tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, sequence models, BERT and transformers.

items.title: Hugging Face NLP Course
items.description: The hands-on course for transformers and modern NLP.

items.title: Speech and Language Processing
items.description: Jurafsky & Martin — the standard NLP textbook (free draft).

items.title: Stanford CS224n
items.description: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning.

items.title: NLTK Book
items.description: Natural Language Processing with Python — classic fundamentals.

items.title: Hugging Face Transformers
items.description: Models and pipelines for modern NLP.

lessons.title: What Is NLP?
lessons.description: The field, the tasks, and the deep-learning revolution that reshaped how machines read language.

lessons.title: Text Representation: From Tokens to Vectors
lessons.description: Tokenization, bag-of-words and TF-IDF — how raw text becomes numbers a model can use.

lessons.title: Text Preprocessing
lessons.description: Lowercasing, stop words, stemming and lemmatization — clean text without destroying meaning.

lessons.title: Regular Expressions for Text
lessons.description: Pattern matching for extraction, validation and cleaning — the precision tool in every NLP workflow.

lessons.title: N-grams & Language Models
lessons.description: Model word sequences with Markov assumptions, estimate probabilities, and generate text the old way.

lessons.title: Word Embeddings
lessons.description: Dense vectors that capture meaning: word2vec, GloVe, and using embeddings in models.

lessons.title: Text Classification
lessons.description: Spam, topics, intent: logistic regression and linear models on TF-IDF — fast and often enough.

lessons.title: Sentiment Analysis
lessons.description: Detect opinion and emotion in text — from lexicon scores to fine-tuned transformers.

lessons.title: Named Entity Recognition
lessons.description: Find people, places, organizations and dates — the extraction workhorse of document AI.

lessons.title: Part-of-Speech Tagging
lessons.description: Tag every token with its grammatical role — the classic sequence-labeling task.

lessons.title: Topic Modeling with LDA
lessons.description: Discover latent themes in a corpus with Latent Dirichlet Allocation.

lessons.title: Sequence Models for Text
lessons.description: Process text as a sequence with RNNs — the pre-transformer era of deep NLP.

lessons.title: LSTMs for Text
lessons.description: Gated memory for language: LSTMs and GRUs that actually hold context over long sequences.

lessons.title: Seq2Seq Models & Machine Translation
lessons.description: Encoder-decoder architectures that map one sequence to another — the basis of translation.

lessons.title: Attention & Transformers for NLP
lessons.description: Self-attention makes every token reach every other — the shift that unlocked modern NLP.

lessons.title: BERT & Pretrained Language Models
lessons.description: Masked language modeling and the pretrain-then-fine-tune recipe that powers NLP.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning Transformers
lessons.description: Adapt a pretrained model to your task with the Hugging Face Trainer — clean and reproducible.

lessons.title: Question Answering
lessons.description: Extractive and generative QA — from span prediction to retrieval-augmented answers.

lessons.title: Text Summarization
lessons.description: Extractive and abstractive summaries with pretrained sequence-to-sequence models.

lessons.title: NLP Evaluation Metrics
lessons.description: Perplexity, BLEU, ROUGE and human judgment — measuring language models honestly.

lessons.title: NLP Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course, pick a specialization, and connect NLP to generative AI and LLM engineering.
